Commentary.Commentary: Right then, Bangladesh have sealed the series win and extended their unbeaten streak against West Indies to 10! The Bangladesh ODI fairy tale continues. The 3rd ODI will be played at the same venue on Saturday, the 16th of July at 7.00 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). But do join us in advance for the build-up. Till then, goodbye and take care!

The skipper of Bangladesh, Tamim Iqbal says they are very proud to perform in this format. They were not happy when the results were not going their way in this tour but the staff and players were keen to win it. Adds that the next ODI World Cup is the biggest event and they need to get a proper balance. Shares that in the Test match, he got runs but failed to make it big. He just tries to be in the rhythm. On Nasum Ahmed, he is brilliant and was unbelievable with the ball.

Nicholas Pooran, the West Indies captain says it was a tough day and does not really want to talk about it. Says that they need to chat about what went wrong and work out what is going wrong. Says they need to apply themselves while batting and the team are like a family and they will work it out together. He informs that they have not been able to score more than 200 runs recently and they are a young group and will figure it out soon. Accepts that they need to bat properly and get a good total on the board and says more they play and stick together they will get better. Says the need to keep fighting and overcome the challenges and eventually figure out a way to win.

Nasum Ahmed is the Player of the Match for his exceptional bowling effort. He says he was excited for the opportunity. Adds that he just tried to bowl in the right areas and tells that his new celebration means - a new tiger is coming.
Stay tuned for the Presentation...

It was hard on the bowlers of West Indies! They didn't have enough runs to play with and the spinners were not that tight as well. Gudakesh Motie got a breakthrough but they failed to create enough chances to ask questions. The first innings almost declared the results as the Windies batters failed miserably. Bangladesh came with three spinners and took 8 wickets overall. More than their bowling it was the Windies' batting that lacked a good effort.

The Bangladeshi batters showed that with calmness and game awareness, a foundation could've been set up but it lacked from the Windies' side. Bangladesh started with discipline and once both the openers had an eye on how the pitch is playing, they started to score runs freely. Najmul Hossain Shanto fell but Litton Das made sure there was no further damage done. The skipper showed resilience and scored a fifty in the process.

A comprehensive win for Bangladesh! It was never in doubt and more than half of their job was done by the bowlers and there were not many hiccups with the bat as well. With that, Bangladesh seal the series as they go 2-0 up with a comprehensive 9-wicket win!

FOUR! Bangladesh have won this match and sealed the series! Tamim Iqbal reaches a well-deserved half-century! Full delivery outside off, Tamim Iqbal hits this straight back to the right of the bowler. This is hit straight and beats the mid off fielder to reach the long on fence for the winning boundary! Bangladesh win by 9 wickets.
A bit of halt as Gudakesh Motie gets hit on his fingers. It's on the left-hand and the physio is out to assist him. It's his bowling hand as well. The magic spray is out and we are ready to resume.

Gudakesh Motie flights this full outside off, Tamim Iqbal works this towards cover-point and looks for a single. Changes his mind and sends Litton Das back. The throw from Nicholas Pooran is hard and may have injured the bowler!
Full once again and straight. Tamim Iqbal knocks this back down the pitch.
Gudakesh Motie serves this full and in line with the stumps. Tamim Iqbal defends this back to the bowler.

FOUR! Two boundaries in a row and the scores and level! Akeal Hosein darts this one short and quick outside off, Litton Das goes back in the crease and cuts it late to the right of the first slip fielder to the wide third man fence for four more runs! Just one more needed and the skipper will be on strike to complete the victory!
FOUR! Litton Das wants to end this in a hurry! Akeal Hosein serves this full and on the pads, Litton Das is down the wicket in a flash to loft it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary!
Full delivery on middle and leg, Litton Das plays this towards mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads from a shorter length. Tamim Iqbal works it to square leg for a single. 100 comes up for Bangladesh!
Goes a fraction fuller but still straight.  Tamim Iqbal knocks this back to the bowler.
Akeal Hosein starts off with a shorter delivery in line with the stumps. Tamim Iqbal nudges it to mid-wicket.
Too full and on the pads. Iqbal tucks it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! 11 runs now needed! Too full and outside off. Iqbal reverse sweeps it through point for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Das gets forward to block it.
Tossed up on off. Defended out.
Shorter and outside off. Das clears his front leg and pushes it to point.

Drinks! Bangladesh need just 16 runs and it should be an easy win for them. This should be a straightforward win for them. West Indies can only hope they get a couple of wickets in an over and try and halt the results.

FOUR! That is a trademark Tamim Iqbal! Full delivery outside off, Tamim Iqbal gets a commanding stride forward and works this in the gap between cover and mid off for a beautifully timed boundary! 10 runs have come off this over and Bangladesh just need 16 runs to win!
Keemo Paul delivers a full toss on the pads, Litton Das flicks towards backward square leg for a single.
On a good length outside off, Litton Das taps this towards backward point.
Full and angling into the pads, Litton Das works this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and down leg side and this has been punished!  Keemo Paul bangs it in and Litton Das has all the time in the world to pull this to backward square leg for a boundary!
Keemo Paul goes 'round the wicket and angles this into the left-hander from outside of on a good length. Tamim Iqbal works it to the left of mid on for a single.
This one lands on middle, fuller and spins away. Das prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! 10 runs now in three balls! Too full in the slot. Das lofts it over the bowler's head for four.
Tossed up on off. Das drills it wide of mid on for a couple of runs. 6 runs in two balls.
FOUR! Shorter outside off and stays low. Das is quick as he gets low and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Gudakesh Motie bowls a similar delivery full outside off, manages to get the outside edge this time but falls short of the second slip fielder.
Huge turn first up from Gudakesh Motie! Pitches this full outside off, and gets the ball to leave the batter sharply. Beats the outside edge of the bat.
Full and on off. Das tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Iqbal on drives it to mid on. The fielder there dives to his right and half-stops it. It rolls to long on and the batters get three runs.
On middle, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Slower, full and outside off, pushed to mid off.
A huge appeal for LBW but not given! This is full and slanting around off. Iqbal looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto the pads.
Angles it on the pads. Iqbal whips it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Keemo Paul to bowl now.
Gudakesh Motie goes closer to the stumps from a shorter length, Litton Das dabs this towards cover-point.
Shorter delivery on middle. Litton Das works this towards cover.

FOUR! Litton Das gets his first boundary but not in a convincing manner! Gudakesh Motie flights this one full on middle, Litton Das gets down the wicket and hits the ball straight with the lower part of his bat. The ball loops in the air and goes to left of the diving mid on fielder towards the long on boundary for four runs!
Gudakesh Motie goes full this time angled into the pads, Tamim Iqbal works this to long on for a single.
Short delivery turning in from outside off, Tamim Iqbal tries to make room but only manages to play it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Lucky boundary for Tamim Iqbal! Gudakesh Motie goes full outside off, Tamim Iqbal goes for the reverse sweep and gets a bottom edge past his legs to fine leg for another boundary!
Hard length, around off, moving away. Das stays back and taps it on the surface.
Tossed up, outside off. Iqbal steps across to keep it out.
Three runs! Flatter and on leg. Das hits it through mid-wicket for three runs.

What happened there! The ball just dyes off the surface! This is full and on middle. It doesn't bounce as all off the deck but Iqbal manages to get some part of bat on it. Otherwise, it was dead in front. A single as it rolls to square leg.
FOUR! Hit hard! Too full and outside off. Iqbal reverse sweeps it hard through third man for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, spinning in. Iqbal plays off the pads to leg slip.
Gudakesh Motie goes short and just outside off, Litton Das covers the line of the ball and plays it back to the bowler.
This one is full outside off stump as well. Litton Das connects and plays it towards cover.
Full outside off, Litton Das plays for turn to a straighter delivery, gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full delivery served quicker and in line with the stumps. Litton Das gets his bat to it as it stays a fraction low.
Flighted full outside off, Tamim Iqbal works his wrists and plays it to long on for a single.
Litton Das walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Najmul Hossain Shanto has given away his wicket and Gudakesh Motie draws first blood for West Indies! This one is banged in short outside off, there is extra bounce as Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to pull this high and handsome. Does not get hold of it and holes out to Akeal Hosein at deep square leg who takes an easy catch! Najmul Hossain Shanto would be disappointed not taking his team home.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: Darted on the pads. Iqbal stays back and nudges it to square leg.
Fuller and on off. Defended out.
Tossed up, outside off, it spins and bounces more. Iqbal steps down and across to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but not given.
On the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.

Wide! Not out then! Slower, fuller and down the leg side. Shanto seems to miss his flick. The keeper though pouches and puts up an appeal. The umpire does not entertain and West Indies review it. Ultra Edge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat and not out it is. West Indies have lost both their reviews.
On off, kept out.
Shorter and spinning on middle. Iqbal waits and turns it to square leg for a single.
Akeal Hosein (3-0-14-0) comes into the attack.
Leg bye! Motie pushes it quicker and on off. Iqbal comes down the track and tries to defend but it lobs off the pads and over the keeper for a leg bye.
Fuller and outside off. Iqbal takes a big stride forward and across to block it.
Pushes it through on middle. Shanto sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, eased down to long on for one.
Too full and on off. Iqbal blocks it out.
Wide! Shorter but angling down the leg side. Iqbal misses his pull shot.
Fuller and on off. Iqbal gets across and blocks it.
Powerplay 2 now and West Indies can put 4 fielders on the boundary till the 40th over.
Floated on off. Shanto dead bats it.
Too full and on off. Shanto jams it out on the off side.
Outside off, Iqbal guides it to backward point for a single.
Just a run! Shorter and on off. Shanto skips down and mistimes his pull to mid-wicket. The fielder tracks back and keeps it down to one.
On middle, fuller, tucked to square leg. A no ball given as Pooran overstepped. Free hit coming up.
FOUR! Poor from Pooran! Too short again, slower and on leg. Shanto pulls it late and past short fine leg for a boundary.
Too full and on off. Defended out.
Full outside off, Tamim Iqbal defends this back to the bowler. Maiden for Gudakesh Motie!
Short again and angled into the pads, Tamim Iqbal guides this to the square leg fielder.
Gudakesh Motie goes short in line with the stumps, Tamim Iqbal knocks this to mid-wicket.
Full outside off, Tamim Iqbal goes for the reverse sweep and mistimes it to the slip fielder.
Sharp turn and bounce for Gudakesh Motie! This one is short outside off, turns into Tamim Iqbal and cramps him for space. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short delivery angled into the pads, Tamim Iqbal works it towards square leg.
On off, pushed to covers.
A quicker ball, very full and on off. Shanto tries to squeeze it out but almost ends up dragging it back onto his stumps.
Fuller and on off. Blocked out.
Wide! Slides it down the leg side. Shanto misses his flick. Wided.
Tossed up, around middle and leg, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter again, Shanto pulls it softly to square leg for one.
FOUR! freebie! A juicy full toss on off. Shanto stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Nicholas Pooran is into the attack now.

FOUR! Tamim Iqbal getting a move on here! This is full outside off and Tamim Iqbal gets his front foot to the pitch of the ball and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary! Runs are flowing for Bangladesh now.
Gudakesh Motie fires this one quicker in line with the stumps, Tamim Iqbal goes back in the crease and defends it towards cover.
This is a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Tamim Iqbal tucks this towards square leg.
Tamim Iqbal goes for the sweep now. This is delivered full once again outside off, Tamim Iqbal misses and gets hit on the pads. Big appeal but the impact is outside off.
Gudakesh Motie flights this full and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto sweeps this to fine leg for a single.
This one is full outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes for the reverse sweep and the ball hits the pads and rolls towards backward point.
WIDE! Gudakesh Motie begins with one down leg. Bowls this short and spinning from middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone.
Gudakesh Motie to bowl now.
Fuller and outside off. Iqbal reaches for it and blocks it.

Iqbal was not sure there, how to play and what to play! Tossed up, on off. Iqbal first thinks to play the sweep, then the reverse sweep but ends up trying to defend but still gets an inside edge past leg slip for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Drops it too short and on off. Iqbal stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

This one has been reviewed! Akeal Hosein serves this full outside off, Tamim Iqbal goes for the sweep and the ball turns sharply and shoots up in the air off his arms. The fielder at leg slip catches and is convinced it is out. The umpire though remains unmoved and Nicholas Pooran reviews. Ultra Edge shows no bat is involved and it is off the left-arm. West Indies lose their review!
Changes his line and goes full outside off, Tamim Iqbal lunges forward and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
WIDE! Misses his line once again. Goes down leg from a shorter length. Wide once again.
WIDE! Angles this one down leg as well and from a shorter length. The umpire calls this wide.
Akeal Hosein delivers this full and angling down leg, Tamim Iqbal goes for a reverse sweep and misses, misses the leg stump by a fraction.
Outside off, left alone.
Again finds the fielder! Shorter and on middle. Shanto pulls and finds the man at square leg.
Back of a length and on middle. Shanto pulls it but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Serves a length ball, outside off. Shanto shoulders arms to it.
Joseph keeps it tight on middle. Shanto works it to square leg.
Slightly short and outside off. Shanto hangs on the back foot and punches through covers for two more.
Tad short and on middle. Shanto wrists it to deep square leg for one more. Bangladesh are calm and off to a watchful start.
Fuller and on middle, defended out.
Two runs! Flatter and on the leg stump. Shanto prods and tickles it fine past short fine leg for three runs. Alzarri Joseph chases it out and saves two.
Angling on the pads, Iqbal rocks back and bunts it to square leg for a run.
Pitched up, around off. Iqbal tries to reverse sweep but mistimes it to first slip.
Tossed up on off. Iqbal steps across and drills it to mid-wicket.
Angles across a length ball, outside off. Shanto leaves it alone.
Another beauty! Short ball, around off. Shanto stands tall and lets it go near his eyes.
Tight from Joseph! Length and on top of off. Shanto stays back and guides it to point.
Short in length and on off. Shanto hops and blocks it to point.
Back of a length and outside off. Iqbal upper cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
Joseph hits the hard length, around off. Iqbal gets away from the line of the ball. That was sharp from Joseph.
Slants a full ball on off. Shanto blocks it out.
Too full and on middle. Shanto nudges it to square leg. Good stop there.
Finds the gap! Shorter and outside off. Shanto cuts it through point for a brace.
Flatter and on off. Shanto keeps it out.
Now uses his feet and negotiates this short ball back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off. Shanto punches it off the back foot to mid off.
Length and on middle. Iqbal gets behind the line to block it.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, across, outside off. Iqbal tries to drive it through mid off but misses.
Fuller in length and in line with the stumps, Tamim Iqbal works this through square leg for a brace.
Length and on off, pushed to covers.
Bangs it in short again and straighter this time. Tamim Iqbal ducks under this one and is called wide on height.
Short from Alzarri Joseph and wide from off stump, Tamim Iqbal goes to duck and realizes it's away from him.
Full this time and just outside off, Tamim Iqbal defends this towards cover.
WIDE! Alzarri Joseph begins with a back-of-a-length delivery angling down leg, Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone and is called wide by the umpire.
